### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Name the input and output tokens behind the cost estimate](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3136) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The note under `Est. cost` in a session's cost popover and on the Usage page names the input and output tokens the estimate is based on, and how many other tokens, such as thinking, it leaves out.
- (app, gs) [Footnotes jump in template descriptions, step notes and access docs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3130) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Footnote references jump to their notes in a template's description, a template step's note and an installation's access docs. A step note's text is now the same size as other markdown in the portal.
- (several plugins) [One session-expired message instead of two](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3128) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — An expired portal sign-in reads `Your session expired, sign in again.` everywhere, including the Cluster access status, which had its own wording. A rejected one reads `Your session was rejected, sign in again.`

### Development and CI/CD

- (app, gs) [Every Login Required caller is named; two e2e specs stop flaking](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3137) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Every part of the portal that may open the `Login Required` dialog names itself in the page while it waits. Two browser tests that flaked now wait for what they check.
- (deps) [Update tanstack-query monorepo to v5.104.1](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3132) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (e2e) [A shell-mode agentlab run on a classic-only lab fails, never skips](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3133) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — A browser test run for the Agent Platform shell against a lab serving only the classic portal fails with the cause, instead of skipping every test and passing.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.9.3...v3.9.4
